observed_before_amendment.allowed_prior_information: Only preserved v1 results, the frozen v2 protocol/amendment/input chain, source inspection, non-performance integrity tests, and CI status.

reason: The base protocol freezes one seed per scientific phase, but a phase seed alone does not define which random stream belongs to a particular trial when a future runner contains nested loops.

If one implementation iterates regimes, cadences, candidates, or signal cells in a different order from another implementation, sequential consumption of one phase RNG can produce different synthetic curves while both implementations claim the same preregistered phase seed.

Before any v2 candidate-performance statistic exists, stochastic trial identity is therefore made order-independent: every trial receives its own deterministic RNG stream derived only from its frozen phase seed and a canonical semantic trial key.

deterministic_trial_rng.scope: All stochastic development, calibration, locked-evaluation, v1-comparator-calibration, and generalization-probe trial generation. Cadence generation, reported-error generation, and the separately frozen paired-bootstrap RNG are unchanged.
deterministic_trial_rng.phase_seed_source: Use the applicable frozen base-protocol phase seed. v1 raw-bank comparator calibration belongs to the calibration phase and generalization probes belong to the locked-evaluation seed namespace with role=generalization_probe so their keys remain disjoint from primary locked evaluation.
deterministic_trial_rng.unused_field_rule: Fields that do not apply to a trial are encoded as JSON null; they may not be omitted. trial_index is zero-based within the exact semantic cell named by the other fields.
deterministic_trial_rng.canonicalization: stable_json over an object containing schema plus every canonical_key_field in the listed contract; object key order is irrelevant because stable_json sorts keys.
deterministic_trial_rng.seed_derivation: payload = UTF8(str(phase_seed) + '\n' + canonical_key_json); digest = SHA256(payload); seed_words are the first 16 digest bytes interpreted as four unsigned big-endian 32-bit integers.
deterministic_trial_rng.invariance_requirement: Reordering loops, batching trials, adding another candidate, or refactoring runner control flow must not change the random draw sequence assigned to any existing semantic trial key.
deterministic_trial_rng.collision_rule: A runner must reject duplicate canonical trial keys within one phase/role execution plan before generating outcomes.
deterministic_trial_rng.phase_separation_rule: The phase string, role string, and frozen phase seed are part of RNG identity. Development, calibration, locked evaluation, comparator calibration, and generalization keys may not alias one another.
deterministic_trial_rng.pairing_rule: Methods compared on one paired signal trial consume the same generated curve. Method identity must therefore not be used to generate separate noise or signal draws for paired methods; candidate_id is null for shared data-generation keys and may be used only for genuinely candidate-specific stochastic operations, of which v2 currently prespecifies none.

unchanged: all null and signal trial counts and allocations
calibration, comparator, bootstrap, and uncertainty semantics
all promotion gates and claim boundaries
execution_rule: Every performance runner must verify this amendment before generating stochastic trial data and must construct each trial RNG from the canonical semantic key rather than consuming one mutable phase-global RNG stream.
